validation_gates.reason: The validator runs no schema, so every value arrives straight from JSON. An empty or missing temporal_slice.materialization.artifacts list also passed, although the closure's stated purpose includes the materialized artifact bytes. Identities must now be non-empty strings before they are compared, reusing RUN_ID_MISMATCH, RUN_RECEIPT_REF_MISMATCH and EVIDENCE_REF_MISMATCH, and an empty artifact set reports the new ARTIFACT_SET_EMPTY. Seven of the new tests fail or error on the original code.

tests/validators/test_validate_trace_temporal_closure.py: 14 tests (6 before, 8 new) covering absent and empty identities, unhashable run_ids, the empty artifact set, each reference and envelope rule, closure-id format and recomputation (receipt_ref is not a closure anchor; slice_id is), the CLI on fixtures and explicit files, every reader finding including JSON_COMPLEXITY_LIMIT and JSON_NONFINITE_NUMBER, and fixture replay failing on wrong polarity or an unreadable manifest.
